meta.title: Mixolydian: Where the Leading Tone Goes
meta.summary: Mixolydian is A major with the 7 flattened, which costs it the pull toward home — and its tritone is the two notes of A7, so the mode and the chord are the same idea.

That's the whole trade: the same home chord Lydian and Ionian have, without the note that pulls toward it, and still carrying the note that grinds against it. What that trade looks like drawn as dots in a window — and the one window where flattening a note works in your favour — comes next.
